# Label

**Class:** `UltraCanvasLabel` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasLabel.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasLabel.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasLabel.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Static text - selectable and copyable with `SetSelectable`, or across many labels with one `UltraCanvasTextSelection`

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasLabel> CreateLabel(const std::string &identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string &text = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasLabel> CreateLabel(const std::string &identifier, float w, float h, const std::string &text = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasLabel> CreateLabel(const std::string &identifier);   // One string is the identifier, as the constructor's.
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasLabel> CreateLabel(const std::string &identifier, const std::string &text);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasLabel(const std::string &identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string &labelText = "");
UltraCanvasLabel(const std::string &identifier, float w, float h, const std::string &labelText = "");
UltraCanvasLabel(const std::string &identifier, const std::string &labelText);
explicit UltraCanvasLabel(const std::string &identifier = "");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onClick` | `std::function<void()> onClick` | _Click_ |
| `onLinkActivated` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onLinkActivated` | Fired with LabelTextLink::href when a text link is clicked. |
| `onLinkHovered` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onLinkHovered` | Fired with a text link's href when the pointer comes onto it, and with "" when it leaves the link (onto plain text, or out of the label) - what a mail reader shows in its status line before the click. |
| `onHoverEnter` | `std::function<void()> onHoverEnter` | _Hover enter_ |
| `onHoverLeave` | `std::function<void()> onHoverLeave` | _Hover leave_ |
| `onTextChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onTextChanged` | _Text changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `LabelVariant`

A label's part in the window, which FromTheme maps the theme's ink onto: Body - primary text; Muted - secondary text (a note, a caption, a status line); Faint - a hint, a placeholder; Heading - a panel or section title (ink; a theme may name "label.heading" for its own)

| `Muted` |  |
| `Faint` |  |
| `Heading` |  |

### struct `LabelTextLink`

A hyperlink inside the label's rendered text. Byte offsets refer to the text as laid out (markup parsed, entities decoded) — the same indexing that ITextLayout::XYToIndex reports.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `startByte` | `int startByte = 0` |  |
| `endByte` | `int endByte = 0` | exclusive |
| `href` | `std::string href` |  |
| `quiet` | `bool quiet = false` | Clickable without showing it: no tooltip, and onLinkHovered is told nothing (the HTML reader's &lt;label&gt; text, which acts on its form control). |

### enum `LabelInlineImageAlign`

An image flowing in the text, like a browser's inline <img>: it stands on the line's baseline at the place of a U+FFFC placeholder character in the rendered text, and the line grows to hold it. Wider than the line, it is scaled down to fit, keeping its aspect ratio. Where an inline image sits against the text of its line (CSS vertical-align): standing on the baseline, centred on the x-height, its top at the text's top, or its bottom at the text's bottom.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Baseline` |  |
| `Middle` |  |
| `Top` |  |
| `Bottom` |  |

### struct `LabelInlineImageBorder`

The box around an inline image, as CSS draws it around an inline <img>: margins keep the text away, the background fills the border box, the border is drawn inside it, and padding separates the picture from the border. The picture is clipped to the rounded corners.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `width` | `float width = 0.f` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Black` |  |
| `dash` | `UCDashPattern dash` | empty: solid |

### struct `LabelTextBox`

The box of an inline element in the text (CSS's inline box): its background and border drawn around the bytes [startByte, endByte), one piece per line, behind the text. The bytes hold its horizontal padding and border as room (the HTML reader's U+FFFC placeholders), so the box's sides fall at the room's outer edges; the vertical padding reaches above and below the text without moving the lines, as in CSS. When the element breaks across lines, the left border is on its first piece and the right one on its last (box-decoration-break: slice).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `startByte` | `int startByte = 0` |  |
| `endByte` | `int endByte = 0` |  |
| `background` | `Color background = Colors::Transparent` |  |
| `borderLeft` | `LabelInlineImageBorder borderTop, borderRight, borderBottom, borderLeft` |  |
| `paddingTop` | `float paddingTop = 0.f, paddingBottom = 0.f` |  |
| `borderRadius` | `float borderRadius = 0.f` | on a box that fits on one line |
